newest.title: Anthropic’s Claude 5.5 Launch: Does Lower Cost Mean Better Coding Performance?
newest.description: Anthropic’s Claude 5.5 Launch: Does Lower Cost Mean Better Coding Performance. Anthropic just dropped Claude 5.5 with a 40% price cut and claims of stronger coding skills. We’re breaking down if this is the moment to switch your workflow or just another incremental update. What we covered: • Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5.5 with lower prices and stronger coding/knowledge-work performance • Alibaba unveils new AI chip technology and says it is building more powerful models • OpenAI creates a mathematics advisory group at the Institute for Advanced Study Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways. Listener question: When choosing an AI model for your work, what matters most: the cost, the speed, or the accuracy of the output? What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed.
